name: sunset-modern-fashion-man
image_purpose: Men's fashion social post and lifestyle portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a stylish sunset sidewalk portrait of an approved adult man in modern casual tailoring.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult man with a confident on-camera expression, wearing a navy button-down shirt slightly open at the collar, white fitted pants, and a silver wristwatch.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical lifestyle portrait on a modern landscaped sidewalk beside a quiet road. Include tall trees, trimmed greenery, distant hills, and a dramatic cloudy evening sky with pink and blue tones.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural sunset light, pink-blue cloud glow, gentle shadows, cinematic but realistic atmosphere, natural skin and fabric texture.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm portrait lens look, f/2.0, shallow depth of field, realistic 4K detail, subtle film grain, natural color and balanced highlights.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A stylish vertical sunset lifestyle portrait of one approved adult man standing on a modern landscaped sidewalk beside a quiet road, wearing a navy button-down shirt slightly open at the collar, white fitted pants, and a silver wristwatch. Confident on-camera expression, tall trees, trimmed greenery, distant hills, dramatic cloudy evening sky with soft pink and blue tones, natural sunset light, gentle shadows, cinematic realistic photography, 50mm f/2.0, shallow depth of field, natural texture, subtle film grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, distorted hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, random text, watermark, random logos, celebrity likeness, low resolution, blur

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve approved adult identity, exact outfit, watch, sidewalk setting, landscape, sunset palette, and portrait framing. The reference is replaceable with another approved adult menswear subject while retaining the same calm sunset direction. Explicitly define replacement identity, outfit, product, logo, environment, or typography; do not invent them.
